records.why: Round 2, journal item math_2_5-078 (EDIT?, teacher typed: 'Use the specified KICD CBE rubric'). Deferred: rubric. The KICD Grade 10 Mathematics PDF has four-level rubric tables (Exceeds / Meets / Approaches / Below Expectations) but the partner contract has only three level fields, so no rubric structure change was made; on hold pending the partner. PROPOSED ANSWER (for the teacher to approve or edit): Keep the rubric as the single KICD CBE criterion with all four levels (Exceeds, Meets, Approaches, Below Expectations), using the KICD wording verbatim. The current rubric already follows the specified KICD descriptors, but the 'Approaches' descriptor needs to be checked against the KICD text, and the four levels must stay visible to teachers and learners. Since the partner contract has only three level fields, the Below Expectations level is carried in the existing belowExpectations field (it is in the rubric already). No further wording change is needed unless the partner schema is extended. Teachers can approve the rubric as is. Alternative: Merge Approaches and Below Expectations into one 'Developing' field to fit three levels, but this departs from the KICD four-level rubric and is not recommended.
records.resolved_note: Resolved 2026-11-10: the four-level rubric (Below Expectations) is now in this module's Final Explanation (contract revision R1 and the KICD rubric); the deferral no longer applies.
